items.title: Dick Griffin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 12, 2024
items.q: Yeah that’s my son. And when he was a small kid, like two years old, he would be trying to dance and he would be jumping around and bouncing around and I called it “Jakuba’s Dance.”

ctx.x: I’m not really hearing the keyboard over Zoom. So was there an inspiration for that?
